Spray Dried Green Banana Starch Powder for Food Manufacturers

Green banana powder is made from unripe bananas and has a mild, neutral taste and a starchy texture. Tradenest Naturals supplies green banana starch powder to food manufacturers, bakery brands, beverage companies and supplement makers. Our spray dried unripe banana powder is a fine, light-coloured powder that disperses easily in liquids and blends evenly into dry mixes. Many brands choose it as a simple, plant-based carbohydrate ingredient with a short label.

How It Is Made

Production starts with unripe bananas, carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. The fruit is picked green, before the starch turns to sugar. First, the bananas are cleaned, peeled and processed into a smooth slurry. Next, the slurry is spray dried into a fine, stable powder. Spray drying gives a uniform particle size and good flowability. As a result, our unripe banana powder wholesale lots behave the same way on your production line from batch to batch. We follow hygienic handling practices at every stage.

Functional Properties

Formulators value this bulk green banana powder for its resistant starch content and its body in finished products. It has useful thickening properties, so you can use it to build texture in soups, sauces, baby food and dairy alternatives. Bakers use it alongside or in place of wheat flour in some recipes. Its neutral flavour means it does not compete with other ingredients. It also works well in snack bars, smoothie blends and breakfast mixes.

Quality and Documentation

At Tradenest Naturals, we keep quality simple and transparent. We control moisture closely and keep it below 5%. Our written handling procedures support batch traceability. We know importers need consistent specifications. As a green banana powder exporter, we share clear technical details for every order. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. As a spray dried banana flour supplier, we also provide export documentation support to help your regulatory team with approvals.

Frequently Asked Questions for B2B Buyers

What is the minimum order quantity for green banana starch powder? Our MOQ is 5 Kg. This makes it easy to trial the powder before ordering larger volumes. Contact our sales team for quotes based on your packaging needs. What documents and quality standards apply? We are an FSSAI registered food business and IEC registered exporter. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. What are the packaging and shelf-life options? We offer bulk bags, HDPE containers and custom private label pouches. The shelf life is 18-24 months when stored cool and dry. What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, processing)? The powder is spray dried to a fine 80-100 mesh, with moisture below 5%. Full details are in the specification sheet. How do I request a sample or quote? Use our website contact form or email our team. Samples are available on request, and we reply promptly with technical and commercial details.

Versatile Industrial Applications

Our green banana powder is used across several sectors. It works well in:
  • Nutraceuticals: As a plant-based starch and fibre ingredient in supplement powders.
  • Bakery: As a flour alternative or texture ingredient in breads, cookies and mixes.
  • Beverages: To add body to smoothies, shakes and drink powders.
  • Confectionery: As a functional filler in snack bars and coated products.
